_readme: NOT PUBLISHED. Programs removed from the tool. Kept for the record only.

removed.name: Building Electrification Financing
removed.statusNote: Not on the Climate Bank's current program list (checked October 8, 2026). Confirm with IFA before using.
removed.detail: Climate Bank debt product specifically for heat pump and all-electric conversion projects.
removed.removedReason: Removed by IFA in its October 2026 review of the tool.

removed.name: Carbon Free Schools
removed.statusNote: Not on the Climate Bank's current program list (checked October 8, 2026). Confirm with IFA before using.
removed.detail: Financing and technical support for Illinois school districts pursuing solar, storage and efficiency upgrades. K-12 school districts only. Community colleges are governed by the Public Community College Act, not the School Code.
removed.removedReason: Removed by IFA in its October 2026 review of the tool.
